Mei (People Ops): FYI we've pushed a small handbook update: Home Office Stipend (monthly) + Dependent Care Reimbursement process. Full read: https://redwood.internal/handbook/benefits/home-office-dependent. TL;DR: home office stipend is $50/mo for fully remote staff, effective 2026-05-01; dependent-care reimburses childcare, eldercare, and special needs support up to $600/yr after completing the new Compliance Essentials module and signing the benefits attestation. Managers: confirm your eligible headcount in the benefits tracker by Tue 2026-05-05.

Jordan (HRBP): Quick clarification 14 are contractors eligible for the home office stipend? We have a contractor who works fully remote and asked.

Mei (People Ops): Contractors are not eligible for the stipend; only full-time employees and fixed-term employees on the payroll. If a contractor transitions to payroll within the month we pro-rate the first payment.

Carlos (Payroll): Note on payroll timing: stipend will appear as a non-taxable reimbursement in most US states, but depends on local regs. Payroll will tag payments with "HO-STIPEND" as the paycode. For EU employees we will pay in EUR and use local payroll dates; LJ (legal) approved the approach.

Nadia (IC): Will the dependent-care reimbursement accept recurring daycare invoices or does it need per-event receipts?

Mei (People Ops): Recurring invoices accepted but must show service dates. Upload to the new form (link below) and select "recurring". Finance will verify.

people-ops-bot: Benefits attestation created for Nadia 14 ts=2523456792 14 url=https://redwood.internal/attestations/2523456792

Lena (Hiring Ops): If offers accepted after the Tue cutoff, can we add folks to the tracker mid-cycle? We have three new hires starting 2026-05-10.

Mei (People Ops): Yes, add them and add a manager approval note. We'll run a mid-cycle sync every Wednesday this month to catch post-cutoff additions.

Jordan (HRBP): A reminder for managers: employees must complete the Compliance Essentials module (estimated 20m) before dependent-care claims will process. Please nudge your teams.

Nadia (IC): Where do I upload receipts? The handbook link didn't show the form.

Mei (People Ops): Use this submission form: https://redwood.internal/forms/benefits-claims. Choose "dependent-care" or "home-office". The form fields are: employee email, payroll ID, claim type, dates, amount, upload receipt(s), notes.

Carlos (Payroll): GL codes: home office stipend 7200-HO, dependent care reimbursement 7210-DC. For amounts over $300 in a single claim, we need manager + finance approval.

Mei (People Ops): Action items: managers verify headcount in tracker by 2026-05-05; employees complete Compliance Essentials + sign attestation before filing dependent-care claims; payroll will process stipends starting May payroll run. Ping me for exceptions.

Nadia (IC): Thanks! I signed the attestation.

Lena (Hiring Ops): Added the three new hires to the tracker and flagged their approvals.

Mei (People Ops): :thumbsup: thanks everyone.
